title: The Artificial Intelligence Cognitive Examination: A Survey on the Evolution of Multimodal Evaluation From Recognition to Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the evolution of technical benchmarks and cognitive capabilities like recognition, reasoning, and planning in AI. While it mentions 'Safety & Toxicity Red-teaming' and 'Fairness' as evaluation axes, it lacks a specific component or benchmark for religion, faith, theology, or formal ethics.
